nodes.name: .gitattributes
nodes.summary: Git line-ending configuration enforcing LF for all files and CRLF only for batch scripts, ensuring cross-platform consistency.

nodes.name: .python-version
nodes.summary: Pins the project's Python interpreter to version 3.12 for use by uv and pyenv-compatible tools.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview covering what the app does, how to install and run it, the full feature list with priorities, library dependencies, and cross-platform constraints.

nodes.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
nodes.summary: Authoritative architecture document defining the full module graph, all inter-module handoff data shapes, unit conventions (time in float seconds, pitch in MIDI), and the five chart guarantees enforced by tests.

nodes.name: pitch.md
nodes.summary: Spec for the YIN-based pitch detection module, defining the PitchReading dataclass interface, detect() signature, default parameters, and frame size guidance for reliable low-E detection.

nodes.name: walking-skeleton.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan for the walking skeleton across three PRs: package layout and store in PR 1, prep pipeline stubs and jobs in PR 2, and live pipeline stubs with the demo command and CI in PR 3.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Project build configuration declaring Python 3.12 requirement, core runtime dependencies, an optional ml extra (basic-pitch, demucs, onnxruntime) isolated to avoid Windows wheel failures, and dev tooling (pytest, ruff).
nodes.languageNotes: ML dependencies are split into an optional extra so the base install succeeds on Windows AMD64 where torch/triton have no wheel.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Pytest session setup that generates tests/fixtures/sample.wav (a 3-second 440 Hz sine wave) on the first run using only the standard library, so tests have a deterministic audio fixture without committing a binary.

nodes.name: _make_sample_wav
nodes.summary: Creates tests/fixtures/sample.wav as a 3-second mono 440 Hz (A4) 16-bit PCM sine wave using only the standard library wave and struct modules.

nodes.name: guitar.json
nodes.summary: Fixture chart file for a guitar with two notes demonstrating the chart handoff format: schema_version, standard tuning, capo 0, and notes with id, timing, MIDI, string, fret, and chord fields.

nodes.name: guitar.json
nodes.summary: Fixture raw-notes file for guitar demonstrating the transcribe-to-chart handoff format: schema_version, target instrument, and a list of events with start/end times, MIDI, and amplitude.

nodes.name: sample.wav
nodes.summary: Generated audio fixture (3-second 440 Hz sine wave) used by prep pipeline and ingest tests to exercise the full song processing path without requiring a real audio file.

nodes.name: test_chart_guarantees.py
nodes.summary: Verifies all five chart guarantees from ARCHITECTURE.md against the fixture and unit-tests each clean_notes step (drop out-of-range, drop short/quiet, drop octave doubles, merge same pitch, shift to playable, merge shifted duplicates).

nodes.name: test_guarantee_1_sorted_by_start
nodes.summary: Asserts that all notes in the chart fixture are sorted by start_s in non-decreasing order.

nodes.name: test_guarantee_2_end_after_start
nodes.summary: Asserts that every note in the chart fixture has end_s strictly greater than start_s.

nodes.name: test_guarantee_3_string_fret_midi
nodes.summary: Asserts that tuning[string] + capo + fret equals midi for every note, verifying the guitar string/fret arithmetic.

nodes.name: test_guarantee_4_no_string_overlap
nodes.summary: Asserts that no two notes on the same guitar string overlap in time.

nodes.name: test_guarantee_5_playable_fret
nodes.summary: Asserts that every note's fret value is within the playable range [0, 24].

nodes.name: test_clean_drop_out_of_range
nodes.summary: Unit test for _drop_out_of_range: verifies MIDI notes below 33 or above 88 are removed.

nodes.name: test_clean_drop_short_or_quiet
nodes.summary: Unit test for _drop_short_or_quiet: verifies notes below the duration or amplitude threshold are removed.

nodes.name: test_clean_drop_octave_doubles
nodes.summary: Unit test for _drop_octave_doubles: verifies that quieter notes an octave above a louder simultaneous note are dropped.

nodes.name: test_clean_merge_same_pitch
nodes.summary: Unit test for _merge_same_pitch: verifies that two overlapping notes of the same pitch are merged into one with the louder amplitude.

nodes.name: test_shift_to_playable
nodes.summary: Unit test for _shift_to_playable: verifies that sub-floor MIDI notes are shifted up one octave while already-playable notes remain unchanged.

nodes.name: test_merge_shifted_duplicates
nodes.summary: Unit test for _merge_shifted_duplicates: verifies that a native note and a shifted duplicate at the same MIDI pitch are merged into one.

nodes.name: test_dev_gui.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the dev_gui pure helper functions — verifies pixel coordinate calculations, song listing, stage row formatting, and that importing dev_gui never loads torch/demucs/basic_pitch.

nodes.name: test_no_heavy_imports
nodes.summary: Runs a subprocess to verify that importing lodestone.dev_gui does not load torch, demucs, or basic_pitch into sys.modules.

nodes.name: test_list_songs
nodes.summary: Integration test: ingests a sample WAV, calls list_songs, and asserts exactly one song appears with the correct song_id.

nodes.name: test_formats.py
nodes.summary: Validates that every fixture JSON file (song.json, notes/guitar.json, chart/guitar.json, played_event.json, session_score.json) conforms to the handoff shapes defined in ARCHITECTURE.md.

nodes.name: test_pitch_tuner.py
nodes.summary: Tests the YIN pitch detector (detect()) and the Tuner display logic against synthesized sine waves for all six open guitar strings, verifying accuracy within 3 cents and correct silence/noise handling.

nodes.name: test_open_strings
nodes.summary: Parametrized test verifying that detect() returns a frequency within 3 cents of each open guitar string (E2 through E4) using synthetic sine frames.

nodes.name: test_prep.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the full prep pipeline: ingest, separate, transcribe, build_chart, and the jobs background process, verifying each step writes correct files and all stages reach 'done' after joining the process.

nodes.name: test_ingest
nodes.summary: Verifies that ingest() produces a valid 16-hex-char song_id, writes mix.wav, and sets correct initial stage values in song.json.

nodes.name: test_separate
nodes.summary: Verifies that separate() writes the guitar stem and backing track WAV files to the correct store paths.

nodes.name: test_transcribe
nodes.summary: Verifies that transcribe() writes a valid notes JSON file with schema_version 1, sorted events, and valid MIDI/amplitude ranges.

nodes.name: test_chart_stub
nodes.summary: Full integration test for build_chart(), asserting all five chart guarantees hold on the output written by the stub implementation.

nodes.name: test_jobs_stages
nodes.summary: Launches the jobs background process via start_prep() and verifies all prep stages transition to 'done' after the process joins.

nodes.name: test_store.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for SongStore covering round-trips for song, notes, and chart JSON; atomic write behavior (no .tmp files left); SchemaError on wrong or missing schema_version; and expected path structure.
